scope: All 227 original built-in definitions and 217 distinct positive Steam AppIDs reviewed. Public SteamDB identity and depot metadata where available; seven unusable Windows installer profiles removed, two bundled-server download IDs corrected, GoldSrc selection and The Isle branches corrected. This is not live installation, ownership-entitlement or runtime certification. No installed server data is removed.
